question.text: Category III AIFs enjoy 'tax pass-through' status under Section 115UB of the Income Tax Act, 1961:

answer.text: No — tax pass-through under Section 115UB applies only to Cat I and Cat II AIFs
Yes but only for capital gains

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 297-300, the Section 115UB "Investment Fund" definition is limited to Category I and Category II AIFs, so the Section 115UB pass-through regime does not apply to Category III AIFs. The Trap: The narrow point is about Section 115UB specifically; sweeping claims that Category III can never benefit from any pass-through treatment overstate the source. Note: Pages 301-304 separately discuss trust-tax principles under which an irrevocable determinate Category III AIF may pass through certain non-business income, so trust structure and the source of income can independently affect tax treatment.
